subject: [RFC PATCH 18/57] mm/collapse: install the destinations at PTE level

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch installs destinations at the PTE (page table entry) level as part of a larger effort to collapse memory. It fills in the installation process for sub-PMD candidates, including verification and abort mechanisms. The verify function checks if the window is still valid to publish, while the abort function undoes frozen candidates that cannot be published due to various reasons such as machine checks or racing MADV_DONTNEED operations. The patch also includes a terminal layer for PMD-order candidates and updates the collapse.c file with new code.
